target: National Democratic-minus-Republican margin in the two-party U.S. House popular vote, in percentage points.
poll_average_method: Average of national House polls available in the seven days before the snapshot.
timing_note: The historical poll file filters on archived availability or creation timestamps no later than the snapshot, plus fieldwork end dates. Archive timestamps do not verify when each poll result was first published.
validation_note: National House vote estimates, polling averages, and results are shown as historical context across four election cycles.
